description:
Has the Audi RS5 got WORSE?!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-26-09

It’s time for an Audi RS5 head-to-head! 

We’ve brought the three generations of RS5 together, and we’re going to see just how this high-powered RS has evolved over the years. 

The new RS5 is the first to come with hybrid technology - but will it prove to be a disadvantage? Let’s take a closer look at the stats…

The first RS5 was released in 2010, and it’s powered by a 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8. This produces 450hp and 430Nm, with this power sent to all four wheels via a 7-speed automatic gearbox. It tips the scales at 1,725kg, and as of today, it’s worth around £20,000. 

The second-generation RS5 was first unveiled in 2017. It swapped the V8 for a 2.9-litre twin-turbo V6, and this produces 450hp and 600Nm. This power is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed gearbox, and it’s the lightest of the three cars here, at 1,695kg. As of 2026, it’s worth around £70,000.
title: Audi RS5 V8 v V6 v Hybrid: DRAG RACE
